description: Send from an owned socketspace.xyz inbox when operator-enabled. Free requires verified owner email and permits 30 recipient deliveries/month, 3/day (3 recipients/message); Pro 500/month, 50/day and Team 3000/month, 300/day (10/message). Supply a unique idempotencyKey; reuse it only for retries of the identical message. replyTo is a received message ID for threading. Inboxes with requireApproval enabled reject direct sends. Create a draft and submit it for approval. Suspensions and suppression cannot be bypassed by retrying.

html.description: Optional HTML body; text or html required.

idempotencyKey.description: Unique 16–100 character retry key. Reuse only for the identical message.

replyTo.description: Received message ID in this inbox.

name: send_email
